svg.aria-label: fastCRW leads truth-recall, unique recoveries, median latency, download size and recall depth on Firecrawl's public 1,000-URL dataset
svg.text: Outward always means better. Each axis is scaled to the best result on it, and latency and download size are inverted so a smaller number reaches further out.
Firecrawl's own public 1,000-URL dataset, 819 labeled URLs, all three tools run through the same matcher (diagnose_3way.py), 2026-05-08.
